classification: Present since the web offerings mapper was introduced.
evidence: The initial mapper divides `price` by 1,000,000 but forwards all three period-price `amountMicros` values unchanged. The regression against that historical source produces three failures and two passing null/zero controls; converting the three fields makes all five pass. The parent had no offerings mapper.
limitations: Actual historical mapper and its original fixture helper under Jest, with locally installed test dependencies. No historical web app/backend run. Dependency installation used the historical semver ranges; the resolved lockfile is preserved.
